a: CRP is the sequence to paint pixels: HTML/CSS/JS → render tree → layout → paint.
Reflow recalculates layout; repaint redraws pixels without layout change.
requestAnimationFrame schedules work before the next repaint for smooth animation.
Core Web Vitals include LCP, INP/FID, and CLS for user-centric performance.
LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) measures when the main content becomes visible.
CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) measures unexpected layout movement.
Code splitting loads only needed JS bundles to improve startup time.
Tree shaking removes unused module exports from production bundles.
loading="lazy" defers offscreen images until near the viewport.
Service workers intercept network requests for offline caches and push.
Cache-Control and ETag control browser/proxy caching behavior.
Detached DOM nodes and unbounded listeners/caches cause browser memory leaks.
